description: Assigned to SDWAN, SALMA, WFMTA, and Neucentrix projects. Built and optimized backend systems (data integration, job scheduling, query optimization), designed microservice architecture for SDWAN to improve scalability, developed an interactive dashboard for SALMA with data visualization, integrated RESTful APIs across systems, and deployed projects using OKD for development and production environments.
Developed a fullstack website using .NET frameworks and HTML/CSS, fixed bugs, and wrote SQL queries converted to LINQ for API use.
Developed the internal TestOps website using ReactJS, integrated APIs, implemented unit tests with Jest, and designed new feature pages in Figma.
